title: EvidenceEnvelopeV1
description: Normative canonical evidence envelope for SIH26168 stream observations and recorded events, encapsulating monotonic timebase, provenance lineage, semantic quality gates, and typed payload.

schema_version.description: Major schema version of the envelope contract.

payload_type.description: Canonical type name of the encapsulated payload (e.g., RawSensorSample, LocationGnssFix, UiNavigationSnapshot).

is_finite.description: True if all numerical elements in payload satisfy IEEE 754 isfinite() checks.

is_valid.description: True if payload satisfies physical range envelope and quality constraints.

rejection_code.description: Diagnostic error or rejection code if sample is gated out of core estimation.
